meta.source: London Datastore: London Heat Map - Reports and Data (Greater London Authority)

meta.method: walk-london-datastore.mjs harvest heat-demand: 1 resources (zip); a row is kept when its own EASTING/NORTHING (BNG metres) lie in the 3D model box (E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300); numeric cells are written as numbers. Sheets: the up to 3 rows above the first coded row are kept as header_rows. CSV: streamed; the first line is the header; a row is kept by its first E00/E01/E02/E05 code.
meta.columns_dropped_why: derivable: WGS84 from EASTING/NORTHING (OSTN15); OA, LSOA, MSOA, ward and borough by point in polygon or from the OA through the ONS lookups (statistical-boundaries, zone-codes.json); dropped to keep the file near 5 MB
